title: Ku suka eVuentweni bya Xihlovo
intro: Riendzo ra moya-xiviri lowuntshwa ri sungule hi xivono xa matimba xa mimiri ya le tilweni leyi nkhinsameke hi xichavo. Vutomi bya munhu loyi byi funghiwe hi ku xengiwa lokukulu swinene loku humaka eka lava nga ekusuhi swinene, ku landzeriwa hi malembe yo tala ya ku va mahlonga ni ku pfaleriwa ekhotsweni hi ndlela leyi hoxeke. Hambi swi ri tano hi ripfumelo leri nga tsekatsekiki ni nkongomiso wa Xikwembu, xifaniso lexi xi tlakuke xi suka ekheleni ra le hansi swinene xi va un’wana wa vanhu va matimba swinene emfun’weni lowukulu. Xana u nga paluxa vumunhu bya nandza loyi wo hlamarisa wa Allah?
clues: Ndzi kombiwe xivono xa tinyeleti ta khume-n’we, dyambu ni n’weti swi nkhinsamile emahlweni ka mina
A ndzi ri n’wana la rhandzekaka swinene wa mutswari wa mina, leswi a swi tswala mavondzo exikarhi ka vamakwerhu
Ndzi khomiwile hi vamakwerhu, ndzi hluvuriwa nguvu ya mina, ndzi hoxiwa exihlobyeni xo enta, xa munyama
A ndzi xavisiwa tanihi nhundzu endhawini ya vuxavisi naswona a ndzi rhwariwe ekule ni tiko ra ka hina
Wansati un’wana wa matimba u ringete ku kavanyeta ku xiximiwa ka mina, kutani ndzi hoxiwe ekhotsweni hikwalaho ko ala ku ya emahlweni ka yena
Ndzi katekisiwile hi nyiko ya ku hlamusela milorho, kutani ndzi pfuka ku suka eka mubohiwa la rivariweke ku ya eka holobye-nkulu wa Egipta

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
